title: IMD forecasts heavy rain in Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and other states today - News On AIR
article_text:
India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, West Bengal and parts of North East India till tomorrow.

The Met Department said that thunderstorms and lightning conditions will continue over Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Tamil Nadu till tomorrow. Similar weather conditions are also expected over Puducherry, Karaikal, Vidarbha, Chhattisgarh, Gangetic West Bengal and Andaman and Nicobar Islands during the next two days. Meanwhile, hot and humid weather conditions are expected over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe till tomorrow.

The Weather Agency further predicted a spell of light rainfall at a few places of Delhi during the evening today.

title: Two villages in Mizoram’s Serlui hit by flooding following heavy rainfall - News On AIR
article_text:
Two villages in the Serlui constituency, North Chawnpui and Saihapui ‘K’, have been affected by flooding following heavy rainfall, with residents of flood-hit areas being moved to safer locations. Water levels at the Serlui B Hydel Project reservoir have continued to rise after heavy rain. Residents in the lower parts of North Chawnpui have started moving to safer areas as a precaution.

Saihapui ‘K’ has also been affected after the Tuichhuahen river near the village overflowed and flooded parts of the settlement, prompting residents to leave their homes.

The rising water level has raised concerns that the flooding could worsen, although no major damage or casualties have been reported so far, according to available information.

Serlui MLA Lalrinsanga Ralte has urged the Kolasib district administration to provide all possible assistance and support to people affected by the flooding in his constituency.

The reservoir has received a substantial amount of water following recent heavy rainfall, causing its level to rise steadily. With the water level continuing to increase, residents in vulnerable parts of North Chawnpui and Saihapui ‘K’ have been relocating to safer areas.

ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ 7 ਸਤੰਬਰ 2026

ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਕਈ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਜ ਮੌਸਮ ਖ਼ਰਾਬ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਹੈ। ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੇ ਪੰਜਾਬ, ਹਰਿਆਣਾ, ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ, ਹਿਮਾਚਲ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼, ਦਿੱਲੀ, ਉੱਤਰ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਹਾਰ ਸਮੇਤ 22 ਸੂਬਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੀਂਹ ਦਾ ਅਲਰਟ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਕੁਝ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹਨੇਰੀ ਚੱਲਣ ਦੀ ਚਿਤਾਵਨੀ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਹਵਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ 50 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਘੰਟਾ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਿਮਾਚਲ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਜ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਹੈ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰਪੁਰ, ਰੂਪਨਗਰ, ਮੋਹਾਲੀ, ਪਠਾਨਕੋਟ ਅਤੇ ਨਵਾਂ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ ਪਾਕਿਸਤਾਨ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਸਰਹੱਦ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਕੁਝ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਹਲਕੀ ਬਾਰਿਸ਼ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਆਸਾਰ ਹਨ।

ਮੌਸਮ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਮਾਨ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ, ਮੋਹਾਲੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੰਚਕੂਲਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਅੱਜ ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਮੀਂਹ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹਵਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੱਦੇਨਜ਼ਰ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ ਇਲਾਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਦਰੱਖਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ।

article_text:
By: Dharmendra Thakur
Edited By:Dharmendra Thakur

Weather Today and Tomorrow: દેશભરમાં ચોમાસાની વિદાય પહેલા હવામાનમાં મોટો બદલાવ જોવા મળી રહ્યો છે. ભારતીય હવામાન વિભાગ (IMD) દ્વારા આજે 7 સપ્ટેમ્બરના રોજ દિલ્હી, ઉત્તર પ્રદેશ અને બિહાર સહિત દેશના 15 રાજ્યોમાં ભારે વરસાદ અને વાવાઝોડાની ચેતવણી જાહેર કરવામાં આવી છે. આ દરમિયાન 70 કિલોમીટર પ્રતિ કલાકની ઝડપે પવન ફૂંકાવાની શક્યતા છે. પહાડી વિસ્તારોમાં ભૂસ્ખલનનું જોખમ યથાવત છે, જ્યારે ઉત્તર અને પૂર્વ ભારતના રાજ્યોમાં નદીઓના જળસ્તરમાં વધારો થઈ શકે છે. તેજ પવન અને વાવાઝોડાને કારણે ખેતરોમાં ઊભા પાકને પણ નુકસાન થવાની આશંકા છે.

હવામાન વિભાગની આગાહી અનુસાર, આગામી 48 કલાક દરમિયાન ઉત્તર ઓડિશા અને ઝારખંડ થઈને પશ્ચિમ બંગાળ સુધી નવું લો પ્રેશર સક્રિય થવાની શક્યતા છે. ચાલો જાણીએ દેશના વિવિધ ભાગોમાં આગામી દિવસોમાં હવામાનની સ્થિતિ કેવી રહેશે.
